maddeler.e:
ترتضخوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَضِخُوا (tartaḍiḵū) /tar.ta.dˤi.xuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# تُرْتَضَخُوا (turtaḍaḵū) /tur.ta.dˤa.xuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
